# Skip on windows
if(WIN32)
  return()
endif()

set(TORCH_SHIM_TEST_ROOT ${TORCH_ROOT}/test/cpp/shim)

# Build the cpp gtest binary containing the cpp-only tests.
set(TORCH_SHIM_TEST_SRCS
  ${TORCH_SHIM_TEST_ROOT}/main.cpp
  ${TORCH_SHIM_TEST_ROOT}/test_stable_ivalue.cpp
  ${TORCH_SHIM_TEST_ROOT}/test_pyobject_conversion.cpp
)

if(USE_CUDA)
  list(APPEND TORCH_SHIM_TEST_SRCS
    ${TORCH_SHIM_TEST_ROOT}/test_cuda_graph.cpp
    ${TORCH_SHIM_TEST_ROOT}/test_cudagraph_manager.cpp
  )
elseif(USE_ROCM)
  # Generated by tools/amd_build/build_amd.py. AOTI CUDA graphs, and so the
  # manager, aren't supported on ROCm yet.
  list(APPEND TORCH_SHIM_TEST_SRCS
    ${TORCH_SHIM_TEST_ROOT}/hip/test_hip_graph.cpp
  )
endif()

add_executable(test_shim
  ${TORCH_SHIM_TEST_SRCS}
)

# TODO temporary until we can delete the old gtest polyfills.
target_compile_definitions(test_shim PRIVATE USE_GTEST)
if(USE_CUDA)
  target_compile_definitions(test_shim PRIVATE USE_CUDA)
elseif(USE_ROCM)
  target_link_libraries(test_shim PRIVATE hip::amdhip64)
  target_compile_definitions(test_shim PRIVATE USE_ROCM)
endif()


target_link_libraries(test_shim PRIVATE gtest_main torch ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
target_include_directories(test_shim PRIVATE ${ATen_CPU_INCLUDE})

if(INSTALL_TEST)
  install(TARGETS test_shim DESTINATION bin)
  # Install PDB files for MSVC builds
  if(MSVC AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    install(FILES $<TARGET_PDB_FILE:test_shim> DESTINATION bin OPTIONAL)
  endif()
endif()
